# [CI] Fix mHC numerical test portability across GPU architectures

[Upstream PR](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64876) · state: open · merged: False

## Original PR description

Although these mHC tests pass on the B200 CI machine, they fail on SM120 for two numerical reasons:

1. TF32-sensitive references. PyTorch FP32 matrix multiplications may use TF32 when matmul precision is  "high" , making the reference insufficiently precise for comparisons against FP32 kernels. The tests now explicitly use  "highest"  and restore the previous setting afterward.
2. BF16 rounding differences. Small post-stage rounding differences can cause the final comparison to fail. The unfused path now checks post separately and compares pre using the same BF16 residual.

These are test-reference fixes; production kernels and tolerances remain unchanged. The mechanisms were reproduced locally on SM120;
